_doc: Config of tools/art/animal_sit.py: SEATED sheets of animals (drawn leaning over a desk, writing), and how each is placed in the engine's 34 x 32 frame. See docs/study/library.md, 'Characters'.

pose._doc: base: the frame row the bottom of the figure is on (the lap line); neck (front view): the frame row the neck is on (the table covers what is below it); torso (side views): the frame column the torso (the jumper's mean column) is on for the right-facing pose, the left-facing one is on the mirrored column; cx: the frame column the middle of the figure is on; cut: rows of the figure's bottom dropped (the back view is cut like a person's stool frames)
